cues.text: How does an agent choose a scene without guessing a template?
Intent becomes structure through machine-readable slots and limits.
The agent selects only approved component families and compatible motion.
Tools, evidence and data remain modular throughout the workflow.
Human approval remains a required decision point.
One configuration can produce landscape, square and portrait outputs.
Every scene is inspected before it reaches the renderer.
The agent does not guess a template. It selects a storytelling structure.
